# Last Actor run's abort

The API endpoint described in this section is a convenience endpoint that aborts the Actor's last run.

Same as of functionality described in: [Abort run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-abort-post.md)

<!-- -->

## [Abort Actor's last run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-abort-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/abort](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-abort-post.md)
